title: What the Multi-Tenant Portal for partners audit logs record, how to filter and export them, and what their columns hold

what-recorded.statement: Zscaler records the login name and IP address of every admin who logs in to the Multi-Tenant Portal and changes configuration settings, including login and logout records and configuration changes.

quotes: Zscaler records the login name and IP address of every admin who logs in to the Multi-Tenant Portal and changes configuration settings.
Audit logs display an admin's login and logout record (timestamps, actions, IP, etc.) and any configuration change they perform.

filter-search.statement: The Audit Logs page can filter logs by time range, action, category, sub-category or result, and search by resource, login ID or client IP.

quotes: Filter the logs by time range, action, category, sub-category, or result.
Search for the logs by resource, login ID, or client IP.

csv-export.statement: The Audit Logs page can download a CSV file, in which times are in PDT.

quotes: Download a CSV file. The times in the CSV file are in PDT.

action-values.statement: The Action column is the action performed by the admin in the Multi-Tenant Portal and can be one of a listed set of values that includes Sign Out.

quotes: Action: The action performed by the admin in the Multi-Tenant Portal. It can be one of the following:
Sign Out

category-values.statement: The Category column is the location within the Multi-Tenant Portal where the action is performed and can be one of a listed set of values that includes Tenant Group, Policy Template, Admin Management and Partner Settings. The Sub-Category column is the subject under the selected category and can be one of a listed set that includes Tenant Group, Policy Template and Partner Settings. The Resource column is the item within the selected sub-category, and the page lists Resource, Login ID and Client IP under it.

quotes: Category: A location within the Multi-Tenant Portal where the action is performed. It can be one of the following:
Sub-Category: The subject under the selected category. It can be one of the following:
Tenant Group
Policy Template
Admin Management
Partner Settings

fields.statement: Each audit log entry also has Client IP (the admin's source IP), Interface, Result (success or failure) and Cloud columns.

quotes: Client IP: The source IP address for the admin.
Interface: The interface through which the action is performed.
Result: The outcome of an action, success or failure.
Cloud: The cloud on which the action is performed.

purpose.statement: Audit logs show changes such as policy template modifications and alterations to admins or tenant groups, and support detecting and investigating suspicious activity and tracking unauthorized access to the Multi-Tenant Portal.

quotes: View changes made in the Multi-Tenant Portal, such as policy template modifications, alterations to the admins or tenant groups, etc.
Detect and investigate suspicious activity, and track unauthorized access to the Multi-Tenant Portal.

retention.title: How long Multi-Tenant Portal audit logs are retained
retention.detail: The audit logs article does not state a retention period.
